page.overview:
Who is Auru?

Auru is one of the members of The Resistance, and appears to be the oldest of the group. He is fairly knowledgeable about the Gerudo Desert and the evils that reside there. He appears to have known the Sages who guard the Mirror of Twilight at some point it was apparently they who first told him of the mirror and its location. In the original Japanese version, He also tutored Princess Zelda at some point.

Link first meets him in southwestern Lake Hylia at the top of a tall lookout tower. Though he tells Link that the road leading to the desert is impassable, he nevertheless aids Link in traveling there, through the use of Fyer's Cannon. The Memo he gives Link instructs Fyer to send Link to the desert for free, a request Fyer cannot refuse due to the fact that Auru saved Fyer's life a long time ago. Using Fyer's Cannon, Link gains access to the Gerudo Desert and eventually, the Mirror of Twilight. After completion of the Arbiter's Grounds, Auru can be met at any time in Telma's Bar.
